Common questions

What happens if my trap needs a repair?

It depends on your plan. Rental customers pay nothing. We own the equipment, so we cover all parts and labor. CO₂ Delivery and Buy customers own their trap, so repairs are handled by us but billed separately for parts and labor.

Can I switch plans later?

Yes. If you start with CO₂ delivery and decide you want to upgrade to a rental, just let us know. We will swap out your equipment at the next scheduled visit.

Does the shop equipment work with your delivery service?

Yes. If you purchase a trap from our shop, we can enroll you in CO₂ Delivery service right away. The traps we sell are the same models we install for rental customers.

Is the barrier treatment available on its own?

No. Barrier treatment is an add-on for active CO₂ trap customers only. It works by masking human scent and redirecting mosquitoes toward your trap, so a running trap is required.
